# Method-table address computation must follow its nil check. Ownership probes
# make that derived address live across calls; nil+offset is not a GC pointer.
# Force stack growth and GC in an earlier call, then verify ordinary nil panic
# ordering and nonnil dispatch in both instrumentation levels and with race.
[short] skip
go build -gcflags=example.org/nilinterface=-d=isolateheap=1 -o check.exe .
exec ./check.exe
stdout '^nil-interface stack ordering passed$'
go build -gcflags=example.org/nilinterface=-d=isolateheap=2 -o check.exe .
exec ./check.exe
stdout '^nil-interface stack ordering passed$'
[race] go build -race -gcflags=example.org/nilinterface=-d=isolateheap=2 -o check.exe .
[race] exec ./check.exe
[race] stdout '^nil-interface stack ordering passed$'

-- go.mod --
module example.org/nilinterface
go 1.26
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
)

type message interface{ Descriptor() any }
type value struct{}
func (value) Descriptor() any { return "descriptor" }
type registry struct{ count int }
var global registry
var mu sync.Mutex
var preparations int

//go:noinline
func prepare(string) {
	preparations++
	grow(32)
	runtime.GC()
}

//go:noinline
func grow(depth int) {
	var pad [4096]byte
	if depth > 0 {
		grow(depth - 1)
	}
	runtime.KeepAlive(&pad)
}

//go:noinline
func (r *registry) register(_ string, descriptor any, _ message) error {
	if descriptor != "descriptor" { panic("wrong descriptor") }
	return nil
}

//go:noinline
func (r *registry) RegisterMessage(mt message) error {
	prepare("registration")
	md := mt.Descriptor()
	if r == &global {
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
	}
	if err := r.register("message", md, mt); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	r.count++
	return nil
}

func main() {
	for i := 0; i < 100; i++ {
		func() {
			defer func() {
				if recover() == nil { panic("nil interface did not panic") }
			}()
			global.RegisterMessage(nil)
		}()
		if err := global.RegisterMessage(value{}); err != nil { panic(err) }
	}
	if preparations != 200 || global.count != 100 {
		panic("preparation or dispatch ordering changed")
	}
	fmt.Println("nil-interface stack ordering passed")
}
